denied_suffixes.note: changes network routing of the harness and of every command

overlaps.name: AWS_REGION
overlaps.reason: application configuration; the Claude CLI reads it only after a CLAUDE_CODE_USE_* provider selector, which the CLAUDE_ prefix denies

overlaps.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AWS_PROFILE
overlaps.reason: application configuration; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
overlaps.reason: cloud credential used by builds and tests; no effect on the CLI while no provider selector is set

overlaps.name: CLOUD_ML_REGION
overlaps.reason: read by the CLI only with the Vertex selector, which is denied by the CLAUDE_ prefix

overlaps.name: CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK
overlaps.reason: provider selector; user variables cannot change the provider the worker selects

overlaps.name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: request timeout of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: MAX_THINKING_TOKENS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: thinking budget of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS
overlaps.reason: harness control outside the denied prefixes: tool output bound of the Claude CLI

overlaps.name: DISABLE_TELEMETRY
overlaps.reason: feature switch read by the Claude CLI; denied by the DISABLE_ prefix

overlaps.name: HTTPS_PROXY
overlaps.reason: network routing of the harness process; denied by the _PROXY suffix

overlaps.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
overlaps.reason: provider credential selection for Codex; denied by the OPENAI_ prefix

overlaps.name: NO_COLOR
overlaps.reason: read by commands the agent runs; the app-server environment never receives user variables

overlaps.name: NODE_ENV
overlaps.reason: application configuration; the Claude CLI and every Node tool read it only to select development or production behaviour, it carries no endpoint, credential or path

overlaps.name: DEBUG
overlaps.reason: the Claude CLI treats DEBUG like DEBUG_SDK, but the pinned SDK (sdk.mjs) deletes DEBUG from the env of the CLI it spawns unless DEBUG_CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK is set, and that name is denied; DEBUG is therefore allowed for application stacks. Recheck on every SDK bump (a test that DEBUG is absent from the spawned CLI env is planned)

overlaps.name: TZ
overlaps.reason: application configuration; changes timestamps only

overlaps.name: FORCE_COLOR
overlaps.reason: application configuration; changes terminal colour only

overlaps.name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
overlaps.reason: read by the CLI only after the Bedrock selector, which the CLAUDE_ prefix denies

overlaps.name: AWS_CA_BUNDLE
overlaps.reason: cloud SDK trust roots used by builds and tests; the CLI reads it only on the Bedrock path

overlaps.name: PIP_CERT
overlaps.reason: package-manager configuration; package-manager names stay allowed

overlaps.name: NODE_AUTH_TOKEN
overlaps.reason: package-registry token read by npm; package-manager names stay allowed

overlaps.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
overlaps.reason: application telemetry configuration; the CLI can only enable telemetry through denied switches (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY, ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED, BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT) or managed policy settings, which the worker does not ship; the CLI-only content switches (OTEL_LOG_*) are denied

overlaps.name: EDITOR
overlaps.reason: interactive tool configuration; no effect on the provider, credentials, git authority or managed directories

overlaps.name: BROWSER
overlaps.reason: interactive tool configuration; used only to open login URLs

overlaps.name: UV_INDEX_URL
overlaps.reason: package-manager (uv) configuration; package-manager names stay allowed
